description: 🎨 Andrey Tkachenko – Russian Illustrator & Designer Andrey Tkachenko is a freelance illustrator and industrial designer based in Nizhny Novgorod, Russia . His work blends concept art, motion graphics, and illustration , often exploring futuristic themes and sleek mechanical aesthetics. He’s especially known for his car concept designs , which showcase a unique fusion of elegance and innovation.
